about:
# Wowish

A small, passive advisor for **WoW Forever** (1.60.1), for players who want no leveling guide: no route, no
arrow to follow, no quests taken for you. Out of combat it shows the few things worth doing next for your character:

- quests ready to hand in, grouped by where you hand them in;
- new spells or ranks waiting at your class trainer (and where the nearest one is);
- gear about to break, and the nearest repair NPC;
- a gold plan: saving from level 30 for Apprentice Riding at 40 (100g, 90g at Honored; paladins and warlocks
  get it from a class quest) and from 50 for Journeyman Riding at 60 (1000g), then the way to your riding trainer;
  what the next class training costs (as asked at your trainer, else an estimate) and what is free to spend;
- unspent talent points;
- bags almost full;
- a quest log almost full, and grey quests that give no XP any more;
- where to keep questing (never a dungeon or battleground);
- Hunters: vendor ammo that matches your weapon and level;
- at a quest with rewards to choose from, the one worth taking (a higher item level of your armor type, else the
  one that sells for the most), marked and explained in chat; you still pick it.

It never acts in combat, never moves your character or casts anything for you, never takes or hands in quests,
and sets a waypoint only when you click one. English and Romanian.

Optional vendor helpers, all off until you turn them on (Options > AddOns > Wowish): sell grey items, repair, and
for Hunters top up ammo (never with the gold kept for riding). They run only while a vendor window you opened is
shown; hold Shift as it opens to skip them. With OneForAll or Polestar loaded, Wowish leaves selling and repairs to
them.

## Use
- The **minimap button** (left-click: window, right-click: settings, drag: move; the number is how many tips are
  waiting), `/wowish`, the Addon Compartment, or a key you set in Key Bindings > AddOns: open/close the window.
- Optional: a one-line bar under the minimap with the current #1 tip (Options > AddOns > Wowish).
- Hover a card for its full text and a small x to hide it. Cards with a place have Take me there, the zone tip
  has Map, and talent, trainer and bag tips name the key that opens that window. Buttons never act for you.
- `/wowish go N`: take me there for tip N. `/wowish hide N`: hide tip N (same as its x); `/wowish snooze N`: for 30 minutes; `/wowish unhide`: bring them back; `/wowish new`: what is new. `/wowish clear`: stop it. `/wowish welcome`: the welcome screen.
  `/wowish report`: versions, helpers and recent errors, to paste into a bug report.
- After a level-up, one chat line says what is new at your trainer and whether you have talent points to spend.
- Options > AddOns > Wowish: language, login and level-up lines, window size, which tips to show.

## Optional helpers
- **QuestieDB**: adds where to go (turn-in NPCs, ammo vendors, class trainers, repair NPCs, flight masters). Read at run time; nothing is copied.
  Without it, Wowish still remembers the repair vendors and class trainers you have visited and sends you back to
  the nearest one. A repair or trainer tip moves up the list when its NPC is within 200 yards.
- **TomTom**: waypoints use its arrow; without it, the game's own map pin.
- **ShortestPathForever**: "Take me there" asks it for the real route (walking, flights, boats, portals), drawn on
  the map and minimap, and cards show the travel time. Without it, Wowish draws a straight-line guide on the
  minimap (dots and an edge arrow; it does not know roads or flights) and, when your inn is next to the place and
  you are far away, says that your Hearthstone is ready.
- **Commissions Forever**: a card when a commission in your log has all its materials in your bags; its button asks
  Commissions Forever for the route to the hand-ins.

## Development
Lua 5.1 with busted and luacheck: `luacheck *.lua spec && busted`. Design: `DESIGN.md`. Releases are built by
the BigWigs packager from `v*` tags.

## License
GPL-3.0-or-later (`LICENSE`). Third-party data and credits: `THIRD_PARTY.md`.

## [v0.6.1](https://github.com/SimaAlexandru99/wowish-addon/tree/v0.6.1) (2026-11-18)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/SimaAlexandru99/wowish-addon/compare/v0.2.0...v0.6.1) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/SimaAlexandru99/wowish-addon/releases)

- Merge pull request #10 from SimaAlexandru99/feat/v06-launch-polish  
    v0.6.1 to main: Hearthstone hint, quest log tips, trainer on any client language  
- v0.6.1: Hearthstone hint, quest log tips, trainer on any client language (#9)  
    * fix: know the class trainer on clients in any language  
    The trainer window is matched by the client's own spell names as well as the  
    English ones in our data, so the training cost and the visited trainer place  
    are recorded on non-English clients too.  
    * feat: tips for quests that give no XP and a nearly full quest log  
    Three or more unfinished trivial quests get a low tip naming them; two or  
    fewer free quest log slots get a tip that rises when the log is full and names  
    the grey quests to drop first. Wowish never abandons a quest.  
    * feat: Hearthstone hint when your inn is next to a tip's place  
    Text only, on the card and after Take me there; never a button, never a  
    priority change, and left to ShortestPathForever when it is installed. The inn  
    is learned per character when the player binds or lands after a Hearthstone  
    cast. GuideOffset can now measure between two places.  
    * fix: review findings on the Hearthstone hint  
    The inn is learned from a short timer after the cast instead of zone events  
    (an event can fire before the teleport, none fires inside the inn's subzone),  
    tips refresh only when the stone changes state instead of on every cooldown  
    event, the global cooldown counts as ready, and the far-distance rule has a  
    test that fails without it.  
    ---------  
- Merge pull request #8 from SimaAlexandru99/feat/v06-launch-polish  
    v0.6.0: visited places, right-here boost, level-up line  
- fix: review findings on v0.6  
    The level-up line waits for an evaluation made after the level-up (hiding a  
    tip no longer uses it up), a hand-edited place name or class cannot break a  
    tip, learning a trainer place cannot stop the cost recording, a positive test  
    for the visited class trainer, and the docs name the English-client limit.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- docs: v0.6.0 changelog, README and design notes  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- feat: one chat line after a level-up with what is new  
    Built from the trainer and talents tips that already exist, plus the training  
    cost; printed after combat like the login line, silent when nothing is due,  
    and can be turned off in the settings.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- feat: repair and trainer tips move up when the NPC is right here  
    Within 200 yards the tip gains 8 priority and says the distance. The test is  
    distance, not IsResting(): a village inn rests too but may have no trainer.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- feat: remember the repair vendors and class trainers you visited  
    NearestService now also uses places recorded when the player opens a repairing  
    vendor or their class trainer, so repair and trainer tips get Take me there  
    without QuestieDB and for NPCs QuestieDB lists with several spawns.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Merge pull request #6 from SimaAlexandru99/feat/v04-vendor  
    feat: opt-in vendor helpers and the gold plan (v0.4)  
- Merge pull request #7 from SimaAlexandru99/feat/v05-reward  
    feat: mark the recommended quest reward (v0.5)  
- fix: never recommend a reward you cannot wear yet  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- feat: mark the recommended quest reward and say why  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- fix: count the repair before buying ammo, record only class trainers, say buying not bought  
    Review findings: GetMoney() lags RepairAllItems in the same frame, so ammo could dip into the riding reserve;  
    weapon, riding and pet trainers overwrote the class training cost.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- feat: opt-in vendor helpers (sell greys, repair, Hunter ammo) and the gold plan  
    Vendor.lua acts only while a merchant window the player opened is shown, never in combat, Shift skips; all off by  
    default; sell and repair are left to OneForAll or Polestar when loaded. Ammo restock never spends the riding  
    reserve. The riding card becomes the gold plan: what is free to spend once saved, and the next class training  
    cost recorded at the trainer per character and level, else an estimate.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Merge pull request #5 from SimaAlexandru99/feat/commissions  
    feat: card when a commission's materials are all in your bags, and say when a route replaced another addon's  
- feat: card when a commission's materials are all in your bags, and say when a route replaced another addon's  
    Reads CommissionsForever.API (Materials, Subscribe) when installed; the button asks it to route to the hand-ins  
    through ShortestPathForever. "Take me there" now says when it replaced a journey Wowish did not start.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Merge pull request #4 from SimaAlexandru99/feat/fund40  
    feat: gold for riding at 40 and 60, with the way to your race's riding trainer  
- feat: riding fund for Journeyman at 60 too, with the way to your race's riding trainer  
    Trainers, home factions and the riding skill line from Polestar (GPL-3.0,  
    credited). Riding is known by spell or by skill line 762, so a different  
    spell ID no longer keeps the card. README: positioned for players who want  
    no leveling guide.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- feat: gold for Apprentice Riding at level 40  
    Saving card from level 30 (100g, 90g at Honored with the home faction;  
    none for paladins and warlocks, no discount for Skyborne), then train  
    now / shortfall at 40-41. No spell costs or skip-training advice: the  
    client gives those only at an open trainer.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Merge pull request #3 from SimaAlexandru99/feat/services  
    feat: trainer, repair and flight-master destinations from one QuestieDB scan; repair tip  
- Merge pull request #2 from SimaAlexandru99/feat/minimap-flash  
    feat: one short glow on the minimap button when more tips arrive  
- feat: one short glow on the minimap button when more tips arrive  
    Not at login, in combat or while the window is open. Alpha 0 -> 0.9 in 150 ms  
    (OUT), back to 0 in 350 ms (IN); no loop.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- feat: trainer, repair and flight-master destinations from one QuestieDB scan; repair tip  
    - Services.lua walks QuestieDB's NPCs once per session in the background  
      (2 ms per frame, paused in combat), using the active flavor's  
      Enum.npcFlags, keeping faction-friendly NPCs with one known spawn.  
    - The trainer tip gets Take me there to the nearest trainer of your class  
      (subname, e.g. 'Hunter Trainer', not 'Pet Trainer').  
    - New repair tip: below 20% durability (75), below 5% (90), with the nearest  
      repair NPC.  
    - Without a route planner, a far Take me there also names the nearest  
      flight master (known flight paths are not checked).  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Merge pull request #1 from SimaAlexandru99/feat/quality  
    v0.3 slice 1: strict widget mock, audit leftovers, /wowish report  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.c
